skill_name: Analyze the given poem and discuss the themes and imagery in it.
workflow: In "Stopping by Woods on a Snowy Evening", Robert Frost creates a peaceful winter scene. The imagery of the snow-covered woods and the farmer’s slow horse all contribute to this tranquil mood. At the same time, the poem is reflective, alluding to loneliness, reflections on life and mortality. The snowy evening and the emptiness of the woods conveys existential reflections on life and death.
